name: brainforge-autoresearch
title: 自动研究
description: Use when user wants to optimize, improve, benchmark, or evaluate a skill's prompt. Triggers on "optimize skill", "improve skill prompt", "benchmark skill", "eval skill", "run autoresearch", "tune prompt", "prompt optimization", "skill evaluation", "A/B test prompt", "find best prompt", "auto-improve skill". Runs automated prompt experiments using the Karpathy autoresearch pattern.
